title: ScenarioConfiguration
description: Schema for the scenario configuration of the traffic simulation

speedLimit.description: Speed limit (m/s). Unless vehicleGeneration.desiredSpeed is set, drivers want 85-105% of it. See docs/architecture/06-scenario-configuration-contract.md section 2.4.

approaches.description: Per-approach overrides. lanes (V1.2) overrides lanesPerApproach for that approach; opposite approaches (north/south, east/west) must have equal lane counts. speedLimit is RESERVED: accepted and validated but not read. See docs/architecture/06-scenario-configuration-contract.md section 2.4.

laneChange.description: Lane changing on multi-lane approaches (V1.2): MOBIL decisions carried out as gradual manoeuvres. See docs/simulation/methodology.md.

accelerationThreshold.description: MOBIL switching threshold (m/s^2): the net acceleration advantage a discretionary change must bring.

safeDeceleration.description: MOBIL safety limit b_safe (m/s^2): the hardest braking a change may impose on the new follower.

politeness.description: Overrides every vehicle class's own MOBIL politeness factor when set.

maxLateralAcceleration.description: Lateral-acceleration limit (m/s^2) on every curved path, signal and roundabout alike.

vehicleMix.description: Share of arrivals per vehicle class (V1.1); must sum to 1. Omitted: every vehicle is the V1.0 passenger car, exactly as before. In a mix, 'car' is the vehicle the fields above describe and every other class uses its own defaults (see vehicleTypes).

vehicleTypes.description: Per-class parameter overrides (research use). Unset fields keep the class defaults documented in docs/simulation/configuration.md.

leftDuration.description: Protected left-turn green duration. Applies ONLY to the default one-direction-at-a-time cycle, which the controller builds when phaseSequence is omitted entirely. A configured phaseSequence has no protected-left phase — permissive lefts during a paired green are arbitrated by the conflict layer — so this value is unused whenever phaseSequence is present, including via its own default.
leftDuration.$comment: Conditionally applicable, not dead: see docs/architecture/06-scenario-configuration-contract.md section 2.6.1.

nsGreenDuration.description: Optional per-corridor override of straightRightDuration for the North/South green phase only (the n, s, ns and sn phaseSequence groups, and the N/S legs of the default one-direction-at-a-time cycle). Omit for the previous, symmetric behaviour: NS phases then use straightRightDuration like every other direction.

ewGreenDuration.description: Optional per-corridor override of straightRightDuration for the East/West green phase only (the e, w, ew and we phaseSequence groups, and the E/W legs of the default cycle). Omit for the previous, symmetric behaviour: EW phases then use straightRightDuration like every other direction.

phaseSequence.description: Ordered signal phase plan. Each entry is 'all_red' or '<group>_<green|yellow>', where <group> is a single approach (n/s/e/w) or an order-invariant paired group sharing one green (ns/sn, ew/we). Omit the property entirely to get the default one-direction-at-a-time cycle instead.

offset.description: Coordination offset in SECONDS: how far into its phase plan the controller already is at t=0. Applied once at reset, and taken modulo the total cycle length, so a value larger than one cycle is not an error and wraps. It shifts the starting point of the cycle only; it does not lengthen, shorten or reorder any phase.
offset.$comment: Single-intersection builds have nothing to coordinate against, so this is only meaningful once corridor coordination exists — see the Deferred log in docs/ROADMAP.md. It is fully implemented and honoured today: FixedTimeSignalController.reset advances the phase cursor by this amount.

circulatingLanes.description: RESERVED / FUTURE-ONLY — accepted and validated, but has no runtime effect. A roundabout's circulating ring count is derived from roads.lanesPerApproach; there is no independent ring-lane-count path in the engine. Retained because asymmetric lanesPerApproach will need a real ring-lane count. See docs/architecture/06-scenario-configuration-contract.md section 2.6.2.

signalControl.description: How a signalised junction times its greens (V1.3). 'fixed_time': every phase runs its configured duration. 'adaptive': the same phase plan, yellows and all-reds, but each green is ended by detected demand (minimum green, gap-out, maximum green; see controller.adaptive). Omitted means fixed_time. Not valid with a roundabout. See docs/simulation/methodology.md.

adaptive.description: Adaptive signal settings (V1.3), used when signalControl is 'adaptive'. Every field is optional and defaults as shown. Cross-field rules: maxGreen > minGreen, extensionStep < maxGreen, detectionDistance < roads.approachLength.

minGreen.description: Seconds a green always lasts, so a standing queue gets moving.

maxGreen.description: Most seconds a green may continue once another phase has vehicles waiting.

extensionStep.description: Passage time (s): the green ends after this long with no vehicle moving through the detection zone of its lanes.

detectionDistance.description: Length (m) of the stop-line detection zone on each incoming lane.

demandThreshold.description: Vehicles detected on another phase's lanes needed to place a call that can end the current green.

ttcThresholdSeconds.description: Time-to-Collision (seconds) at or below which an observed TTC is counted as an event. Measurement-only -- affects only reported counts, never simulation behaviour. Default is a commonly-cited conservative literature value (Hayward 1972 and widely reused since), not a value this project has itself validated.

petThresholdSeconds.description: Post-Encroachment Time (seconds) at or below which an observed PET is counted as an event. Measurement-only. Default is a commonly-cited conservative literature value from SSAM-style conflict studies, not validated by this project. Only measurable for fixed_time_signal geometry -- see petApplicable in the metrics output.

ttcSearchRadius.description: Euclidean radius (meters) within which a pair of vehicles on different lanes is considered for a TTC observation. Bounds the per-tick cost; does not affect simulation behaviour.

desiredSpeedFactor.description: Desired speed as a fraction of roads.speedLimit.
